title: Meituan courier work stoppage and demonstration in Shanwei
reason: The opened report documents an employer-directed wage/workplace dispute and does not identify a demand to the state or state policy, required by the project definition.
notes: The report describes hundreds of couriers and a public demonstration, but the documented remedy is fair pay/allowances and workplace safety from Meituan. No state demand is asserted. The Guardian later mentions this April action but adds no state-target evidence.
